semantics.timing: Continuous combinational connections; no clock or cycle latency, outputs follow input after simulation settling.
semantics.reset: No reset port or reset behavior.
semantics.initialization: No stored state or initialization required.
semantics.input_domain: All eight binary vectors are valid.

numeric.representation: Three uninterpreted packed bits indexed 2 down to 0.
numeric.arithmetic: None; exact bit preservation without rounding, truncation, saturation or overflow.
numeric.bit_order: o0 is least significant bit vec[0], o1 is vec[1], o2 is vec[2].

verification.method: Independent self-checking testbench with explicit TopModule instance.
verification.coverage: Exhaust all eight binary vectors in ascending and descending order, checking vector equality and scalar bits against integer division/modulo expectations.
verification.timing: Allow one simulation time unit for combinational settling after each input change.
verification.tools: Icarus Verilog v12 with -g2012 and explicit dev_tb top, matching vvp; finite shell timeouts for compile and simulation.
verification.success: All comparisons pass and testbench prints PASS; nonzero exit or timeout is failure.
